hash_algorithm: sha256 of NFC(json.dumps(cases, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))) encoded UTF-8
independence_rule: No Article used by the Dev Set (golden_phase1.json) appears here; Law 59/2020 and VBHN 67 count as the same Article.
relevant_unit_groups_rule: One group per gold chunk; a VBHN 67 chunk also accepts the Law 59/2020 chunk of the same Article/Clause when the text is identical (whitespace and footnote marks ignored).
pending: All cases need legal review; any edit requires a new hash and a notice to Team 2.
